svg.aria-label: Three resource gauges measured at the ceiling of one small server. Memory is a little under half full, at 863 of 1,967 megabytes. Postgres query time is a barely visible sliver, because queries stayed under a millisecond against a five hundred millisecond budget. CPU is nearly full at ninety-one percent and is marked saturated. The two resources people reach for first, memory and the database, were never the constraint. The caption notes that three services shared one core, so the proxy, the application and the database were competing for the same resource.
svg.text: ONLY ONE OF THE THREE WAS EVER FULL
